title: St Peter's Ilmer Monumental Inscriptions Surname Index
description: The survey's own alphabetical surname index, mapping each named person to the memorial ID(s) that mention them. Extracted automatically from the digitised PDF.

forename.description: Forename(s) as given in the index; may include a parenthetical note such as '(glassmaker)'

locations.description: Memorial ID(s) this person appears on; 'PREFACE' refers to the introductory text rather than a numbered memorial. Mutually exclusive with seeAlso.

seeAlso.description: This person is indexed under another surname (e.g. by marriage); look them up there instead. Mutually exclusive with locations.
